hero.title: Your data. In your own vault.
hero.lead: Bring physical document storage and digital data protection together. Manage your vault and Secure Folder through the D-GO app.

hero.title: One vault for physical and digital assets.
hero.lead: D-GO combines a physical storage compartment, protected digital storage and a management app for your home or office.

hero.title: Protection starts with the device.
hero.lead: PUF hardware authentication, a dedicated private network and encrypted storage form the foundation of D-GO’s security architecture.

hero.title: Manage your vault. Protect your files.
hero.lead: D-GO Vault Management and D-GO Secure Folder bring device management and data protection into one app.

hero.title: Get started with D-GO.
hero.lead: Learn how to connect the device and explore the app’s features. Contact us for installation files and manuals.

hero.title: Find the right D-GO setup.
hero.lead: Tell us your intended use, quantity and deployment needs. Our team can discuss a demonstration and quotation.

hero.title: How can we help?
hero.lead: Contact us about D-GO products, device connections or technical support. Include your model and app version where possible.

benefitsLead: Keep your documents and essential assets close, with dedicated hardware and app controls.

benefits.title: Physical storage
benefits.body: Store original documents, seals and other physical assets in the built-in compartment.

benefits.title: Protected digital files
benefits.body: Use encryption and decryption to protect data in D-GO Secure Folder.

benefits.title: Device management
benefits.body: Check the connected vault’s status through the management interface.

hardwareTitle: The vault and its companion app
hardwareBody: The device provides physical storage, digital storage and a touchscreen. The app provides Vault Management and Secure Folder functions.
technologyLead: Hardware authentication, connection controls and data encryption serve different roles.

technology.title: PUF hardware authentication
technology.body: A physical hardware key works with the device’s PUF authentication mechanism to control access.

technology.title: Private network
technology.body: The companion app connects to the vault over its dedicated private network.

technology.title: Encryption and decryption
technology.body: D-GO Secure Folder provides data encryption and decryption functions.

technology.title: Document timestamps
technology.body: Document timestamping authenticates information about a document’s point in time.

technology.title: Proof of document access
technology.body: Document access certification provides evidence that a document was viewed.

technology.title: Keys and certificates
technology.body: The app includes functions for managing keys and certificates.

technologyNote: Document timestamping and proof of document access are separate functions. Ask our team about service integration and verification details for your deployment.
dashboardTitle: The device dashboard at a glance
dashboardLead: The touchscreen design brings vault-door status, file counts, storage use and the connected device into one view.

screen.label: Illustrative D-GO device dashboard
screen.example: Illustrative screen — values are examples, not live device data.
screen.appearance: Light and dark modes, with normal and large text options.

connectionLead: Use the device and companion app together on the dedicated network.

connectionSteps.title: Prepare the vault
connectionSteps.body: Connect the power supply and the registered PUF hardware key.

connectionSteps.title: Connect to the private network
connectionSteps.body: Connect your app device to the vault’s dedicated private Wi-Fi network.

connectionSteps.title: Register the device
connectionSteps.body: Follow the app’s registration flow and enter the six-digit code shown on the vault’s screen when prompted.

connectionSteps.title: Open Vault Management
connectionSteps.body: After registration, check the connected vault’s status in the management screen.

downloadsLead: Official installation files and PDF manuals are being prepared. Ask our team about the version for your device and operating system.
checks: Check the power connection and PUF hardware key.
Check that the app device is connected to the vault’s private network.
Follow the app’s instructions for permissions and registration.
If a hardware key is lost, contact support for guidance.

salesSteps.title: Share your requirements
salesSteps.body: Include your organisation, contact details, quantity and intended use.

salesSteps.title: Discuss the setup
salesSteps.body: Ask about device demonstrations, deployment, installation and support.

salesSteps.title: Confirm the quotation
salesSteps.body: Pricing, shipping, regional availability and warranty terms will be confirmed for your order.

regionalNote: For enquiries outside Korea, please contact us by email. Delivery, local support and warranty arrangements depend on the destination and quotation.

ctaBody: Contact us to discuss the vault, app functions and your deployment requirements.

faqs.q: Where can I get the app and manual?
faqs.a: Contact our team by email for availability and the appropriate installation files and manuals.

faqs.q: How do I register a new device?
faqs.a: Connect to the private network and follow the app’s registration instructions. The vault displays a six-digit pairing code.

faqs.q: What should I do if I lose the hardware key?
faqs.a: Contact support. The required checks depend on your registered devices and certificates.

faqs.q: Can I order from outside Korea?
faqs.a: Please email us with your destination and requirements so we can confirm availability, shipping and support arrangements.
